literature.title: Downregulation of PMP22 ameliorates myelin defects in iPSC-derived human organoid cultures of CMT1A.
literature.abstract: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease is the most common inherited disorder of the PNS. CMT1A accounts for 40-50% of all cases and is caused by a duplication of the PMP22 gene on chromosome 17, leading to dysmyelination in the PNS.
